title: How many Facebook ad campaigns are you running?
description: How many Facebook ad campaigns are you running?
transcript: How many meta ad campaigns are you running? How many meta ad campaigns should you be running? The truth is there's no perfect answer, but what we are doing right now is running less campaigns. We are consolidating campaigns. When we start working with a new client, we're normally taking a number of different campaigns and combining them into just one or two. What you want to do is make sure that your budget is concentrated where meta can optimise properly. If you spread your budget too thinly across too many campaigns, you won't get the best results.
